status: first concrete design, no active-source edits or board/native/UI effects

approaches.name: owner-clock certified live segment with native actual frame evaluation
approaches.why: Separates finite proof/lease from continuous actual motion and slow observation/AI/board service. Enables causal moving source snapshots and true frame poses under the same law.

approaches.name: Python sends certified timed poses each render frame
approaches.tradeoff: Can be initial integration fallback if same segment/time contract is maintained; IPC/main-thread cadence and bounded renderer lag must be measured. No uncertified between-frame pose or mismatched source pose.

approaches.name: keep STEP/getter serialization and render a tween
approaches.rejected: Endpoint animation does not resolve frozen source custody, inference exactRoot veto or physical paused world; would violate H09/H10 if presented as continuous actual motion.

minimal_first_run.protocol: new live selector defaultNone; keep actual selected FPGA image/PWM capture. Begin with low actual PWM speedcode2=.025m/s, continuously render0.025m/s, not time-lapse.
minimal_first_run.why_speed2: Existing core source-pose applicability is.25m/15deg. Measured6.14s pipeline at.025m/s moves.154m; with margin it fits current pose applicability while .175m/s would move>1m. This is an honest engineering starting cap, not a manufacturer fact or quality pass.
minimal_first_run.adaptive_limit: v<=min(actualAI speedlimit,operator requested speedcap,remaining valid displacement/(measured latency bound+proof+brake reserve)); angular change also fits15deg. Every limited target travels through real board APPLY/capture.
minimal_first_run.horizon: Prepare several seconds of finite certified motion from current captured target plus stop tail, with enough overlap for measured slow pipeline; never exceed real command12s/source/health/actor deadlines. Use finite canonical subspans<=500ms and same full-volume proof each; renderer follows the entire installed law continuously.
minimal_first_run.worker_model: One authority/native owner event loop never blocks on2-6s RPC or source calculation. One Root-owned board worker serializes SDK/TRACE/APPLY in exact request order; one trusted source-only numerical worker consumes immutable sampling snapshots; one AI child works on bounded public input. Only owner thread verifies worker originals and installs grants.
first_dod: Actual native frame readbacks show monotone advancing pose/time while a real TRACE/AI/APPLY is in flight.
Source EM/ADC receipts tie to actual motion-time SnapshotPose and scoped source computation, with no screen/truth input to AI.
Observed board PWM target drives speed/direction and user pause/speed request is marked pending until captured; new law joins position/orientation/speed continuously.
Original whole-body collision/aperture and brake-tail certificates cover every rendered/physical pose; last-safe boundary stops if no valid successor.
No task-level64/600 cap; finite internal resources roll epochs with custody/terminal evidence. This live path has its own qualification, old batch proofs remain historical.

LivePolicyV1.activation: defaultNone preserves existing STEP/book/native protocol exactly; explicit new live selector and new source4pins only after Root commits them
LivePolicyV1.identity: DEEPEYE-CERTIFIED-LIVE-SEGMENT-V1; bind actual revision2 requirementSHA, world geometry epoch, source/engine/writer/clock policy hashes, hardware build and captured command grant
LivePolicyV1.limits: finite per-segment proof complexity, source pose applicability and watchdog leases; no user-task maximum command count or elapsed duration

input: original immutable passage/Root at real anchor
original current captured FPGA command event and conservative real deadline
original scene/body/WorldBudget bound to same world epoch
command mapping plus measured target and requested finite segment horizon
prepare_live_segment.output: opaque PreparedLiveSegment with complete canonical span chain and all per-span six-face/aperture/solid proofs; never a JSON-created authority
prepare_live_segment.rule: certify every point of requested trajectory and pre-planned brake path; proof failure creates no live installation; finite horizon must fit real grant/source/health/actor bounds

activate_live_segment_once.input: original PreparedLiveSegment + expected active parent/pose cutover + original one-shot CAS fence
activate_live_segment_once.output: LiveLease whose start actual time is acknowledged and mapped to native monotonic clock; no early endpoint Root commit
activate_live_segment_once.continuity: parent.sample(cutover) equals successor start position/quaternion/speed within existing checked export bounds; context/layout/stop generation and command lineage exact

pose_at.input: exact active lease identity + actual ownerQPC sample time
pose_at.rule: sample only within installed certified interval and actual still-valid live/watchdog/native lease; reject before start/after end/retired or changed world; neither snapshots nor labels grant motion

sample_source_at.input: original source capability + actual nominal EM/ADC bin + SnapshotPose at that actual source tick
sample_source_at.output: original sample receipt retains segment/time/pose and readback clock-skew budget; field calculation return latency is separate from sample time
sample_source_at.rule: instantaneous causal acquisition at attested moving pose, or explicitly integrated over a bounded trajectory interval if physical sensor law requires it. Never freeze the drill or relabel stale fault/held sample as fresh. Kernel truth stays exclusively inside source worker

admit_updated_capture.input: new original TRACE observation/AI completion/APPLY capture plus current SnapshotPose
admit_updated_capture.rule: revalidate source-to-current displacement<=existing .25m and forward-angle<=15deg; preserve30deg original native direction applicability, risk/C3flags and independent pair verification. Quantize original advice direction_world against actual current own pose with explicit speed request cap; record both source pose and application pose

request_speed_pause.input: authenticated operator intent with monotone request identity
request_speed_pause.rule: normal speed change is applied to regular min(AI speedlimit,operator cap) projection and real board command; show pending until actual FPGA output captured. Once captured install certified continuous-velocity acceleration/braking segment. Lost/unknown grant triggers original fail-safe and already-certified brake tail; no grant renewal or unknown APPLY replay

rollover.rule: world/passage/goal continuity survives explicit sourcebook/planner/board epochs; each old worker IO has actual terminal/handle/Job evidence before retirement, successor ready before old usable lease ends. No in-place counter reset, reused receipt ID, duplicated board executor, or huge-number claim of infinity.

files_and_ownership.extension: Explicit live native publication/POSE_READBACK lease and clock mapping; managed updater whitelisted only for drill transform. Keep scene geometry frozen and every other writer forbidden. Existing closedSTEP path untouched.
Add live activate/replace/finish joint receipts and single-owner cutover CAS. ClosedSTEP remains unchanged; running segment is not a pending incomplete STEP.
Separate long-lived motion lease from short source snapshot transaction. Reserve snapshots at actual time against active segment without requiring stationary world or a fake closed endpoint.

New live receipt carries segment/time/range/error and native clock/readback witness. Distinguish acquisition instant from calculation/return interval. Retain monotone source bins and no missed-bin backfill.

prepare/validate finite canonical span chain plus brake tail, and sample live path from source/live lease; commit segment activation instead of future endpoint. Reuse all existing continuous geometry predicates; scene truth never reaches planner.
Explicit live state/service_tick/pose_at, actual grant limits and certified braking. Existing command/STEP expiry remains default; never extend hardware12s.
Live-only in-flight inference association allows motion on same world/segment lineage, rechecks live sample applicability at RESULT and APPLY. Old exactRoot frozen inference rule untouched.

Genuine mapped TRACE and captured PWM still sole observation/command authority; source pose time and application pose distinct. Preserve hidden truth isolation, CRC/ARM anti-replay, unknown no-replay.

New exact LIVE_SEGMENT_INSTALL/REPLACE/POSE_READBACK/STOP protocol, immutable canonical coefficients/span knots and time mapping; engine process evaluates lawful actual pose each frame. No video-only tween or endpoint interpolation with unbound source pose.

source_causality.snapshot: Actual tick t: sample active canonical lease at t. Retain old segment strong ref through any in-flight source calculation, even if replaced later; returning result retains old t/pose rather than being rebased to current.
source_causality.native_agreement: Native QPC mapping is established by bounded ping/bracket and acknowledged segment activation; actual per-frame timestamp/pose readback verified against Python law within declared skew+float/export error. Excess lag or clock uncertainty stops, never silently adjusts time.
source_causality.async_result: At completion check same world epoch/geometry generation/no edits and source applicability to actual current pose; discard stale or retired result without applying it. Do not mint a new sample timestamp.
source_causality.source_worker: Geometry/material/kernel remain source-only. Source output exposes original counts/quality plus already-public own pose metadata, never obstacle coordinates or exact collision queries.

smoothness.position_velocity: Segment joins require C0position/quaternion and C1speed. Original constant-curvature spans can form a fine bounded-curvature-slew chain; all microspans certified as one installed motion law, not rendered as stop/go commands.
smoothness.steering: If full C1angular-rate smoothness is required, certify an explicit finite curvature blend or very short monotone curvature-slew spans with a declared continuity/error bound; never interpolate an uncertified arc just visually.
smoothness.pause: Normal pause is a real board speed0/STOP intent; after captured output enter pre-certified deceleration to zero and retain stationary live pose. Emergency expiry/loss keeps its real stop protection; no stale drive command is extended to hide gaps.

lifecycle.sourcebook: Rolling source/book epochs retain active segment and in-flight sample receipts, archive completed records by hash. Same logical world/passage history persists; IDs are epoch-qualified and never reused.
lifecycle.actor: Overlapped prepared successor actor/package identity with actual ready/old IO terminal evidence, handoff under live grant reserve. Keep public/source records scoped to process epoch; no old PID lease relabel.
lifecycle.board: Persistent Root-owned worker and per-request unknown-effect accounting. A new continuous service ABI may roll receipt/journal windows without task termination; if hardware/session reset needs stop, perform a certified brake/hold/reinit and honestly show hold rather than promise zero-gap rollover.
lifecycle.native: Viewer lifetime belongs to explicit user session and heartbeat, not600s. Rolling message/audit epochs with original PID/HWND/exe/creation ownership; no duplicate viewer executor.
lifecycle.limits: Per-proof work, memory, one-use IO, validity, watchdog, missed-readback and resource stop limits remain finite and useful. User-task elapsed/count quotas do not terminate a healthy run.

remaining_real_blockers: Current fourpins enforce stationary closedSTEP snapshots and exact frozen Root during inference; no purely private driver/tween can bypass that correctly. Need explicitly revised live profile and updated4pins, preserving old path.
Current native managed coverage forbids arbitrary processing/writers; Root must implement and inventory only the single canonical live drill updater.
Current H07 math/native still needs actual radius.25 integration and matching pins before any revision2 run; old .15 proofs are not rewritten.
Need actual clock/skew/readback and load/speed/pause measurement; pure software contracts cannot prove native/board behavior.
proposed_worker_python_ownership: New default-off certified_live_segment_v1.py: immutable canonical chain, real-time sampling, finite proof/stop boundaries and token identity. No original4pin source edits.
New live_snapshot_pose_v1.py: typed segment/time/pose/error/readback bracket contract and original-reference retention; pure controls for expired/wrong-epoch/replaced snapshots and continuity.
